decisions.reason: The source explicitly changes only Big Block prize parameters; the Small Block prize amount and pool-based draw trigger remain unchanged.
Changing the Big Block draw trigger and prize amount does not alter the requirement that secondary-sale royalties fund prize pools.
The source does not change ticket counters, eligibility windows, weighting, independence, or post-draw reset behavior.
The referral commission and award of one Small Block and one Big Block ticket remain valid regardless of the changed Big Block prize parameters.
The source changes the Big Block prize amount and draw trigger, not random selection, ticket weighting, or winner eligibility.
The source does not change the manual prize-claim workflow.
The Big Block ticket mechanism remains active, so displaying its ticket counter remains valid; the source does not require prize parameters to be exposed in metadata.
The source does not change the requirement to enforce royalties on secondary sales.
The no-referral mint trigger, random ticket award, and eligible recipient population are unaffected by the Big Block prize parameter change.
The Big Block prize parameter change does not alter email authentication or dashboard access requirements.
The source does not change the fiat on-ramp provider, payment flow, or supported buyer profile.
The source does not change unauthenticated public referral statistics or leaderboard access.
